title: World Bank Space2Stats: population, flood exposure, night lights, built area, urbanisation and hazards aggregated to H3 level 6, for any area
format: Asked on demand, a box at a time, by data/acquisition/services.py, and kept in data/cache/space2stats/. JSON: hex_id, the cell's polygon and the fields asked for.
coverage: The land of the Earth, at H3 resolution 6 (about 36 km² a cell).
licence: CC BY 4.0 for the database (World Bank Data Catalog, dataset 0066915); its layers keep the sources' credits: WorldPop, GHSL, VIIRS (Colorado School of Mines), Fathom flood exposure, JBA and others.
citation: Stefanini Vicente, B. et al. (2025), Space2Stats: a spatial data platform, World Bank, https://worldbank.github.io/DECAT_Space2Stats.
